content.text: `sub.control(1)` has 17 qubits: the control first, followed by the 16 original subcircuit qubits. `compose` needs a mapping for all 17, not just the control. I’ll map `i` to the control and the remaining qubits to the subcircuit in order.

{"command":"$PY - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('buggy.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('# Bug: only providing 1 qubit for compose while csub has 17 qubits\ncirc.compose(csub, [i], inplace=True)', '# Map the control first, then all 16 subcircuit qubits.\ncirc.compose(csub, [i] + [q for q in range(circ.num_qubits) if q != i], inplace=True)')
p.write_text(s)
PY
$PY buggy.py"}
